data.patient_folds: Five fixed patient-token hash groups, full thresholds fitted after model selection

optimization.sampling: One shuffled visit per applicable training record per epoch; frozen extractor features computed on CEDIA GPU
optimization.rhythm_budget: Freeze source mass before the 190-record expansion, equal class mass within each source
optimization.anchors: 0.1 start and 0.15 original teacher KL only where agreement with training target

selection.thresholds: Fixed 19 values .05.. .95; each OOF group calibrated only on other patients; final thresholds from all2027validation records
selection.composition: Chosen heads combined only when every shared tensor matches

supervision: Human flag False weight0.5,True1; positive nonzero diagnostic likelihood weight0.5+0.5*likelihood/100; zero likelihood unknown remains1; binary references unchanged; optional positive class weight sqrt(weighted negatives/positives) clipped1..4
execution: CEDIA GPU only; deterministic algorithms; selected component fits repeated before opening followup
